text:
tasha: deploybot trying to push v2026.04 -> staging, failing on finalizing artifact publish, holding change window.
deploy-bot: ERROR finalize multipart: S3 409 Conflict - incomplete upload parts. upload_id=zk9f-778, attempts=9 :frowning:
dan: can someone grab the deploy logs? quick look pls - is it auth or mirror?
jen: looks like mirror-eu2 returned 409 on CompleteMultipartUpload, same symptom we saw in #eng-releases last month but lower volume.
infra-bot: recent event: mirror-eu2 proxy returned 502/409 at 2026-03-23T16:10Z, rate-limit reapplied to client-ip-range 10.84.0.0/14. ref internal: https://status.internal/mirror-eu2
rory: risk assessment: we can either wait for mirror to recover (est. 30m), or manual-promote the last-good digest to avoid missing the change window. which parts of the release are blocked?
tasha: build contains a metrics dashboard tweak (low-risk). PM says not mandatory in this window. primary risk is violating scheduled rollout timing.
dan: if we promote previous digest, we should open a hotfix for metrics patch and mention it in release notes. also consider disabling multipart parallelism as workaround in deployctl and retry once mirror is healthy.
jen: we attempted disable-parallel last time and saw slightly higher success rate. command to retry: `deployctl upload --serial --timeout=90s --upload-id=zk9f-778`
release-bot: FYI release window closes at 2026-03-23T17:00Z. Current time ~16:20Z.
tasha: proposal: try a guarded retry for 15m using serial mode; if still failing, manual-promote previous digest and call it. agree?
rory: +1. document the decision in release notes and create follow-up ticket to evaluate mirror failover behavior.
infra-bot: tail of logs: ```
2026-03-23T16:11:02Z complete-multipart failed: 409 Conflict
2026-03-23T16:11:05Z aborting multipart: cleanup started
2026-03-23T16:12:40Z retrying upload (mode=parallel)
2026-03-23T16:13:20Z part upload 23/64 err=502 Bad Gateway
```
dan: ugly. ops oncall - can you start the serial retry and watch?
jen: ops didn't respond yet. pinging @rory to take ownership if ops unavailable.
rory: I'll run the serial retry now and monitor. kicking: `deployctl upload --serial --timeout=90s --check-complete`
deploy-bot: upload retry initiated (upload_id=zk9f-778, mode=serial)
infra-bot: mirror-eu2 shows partial heal at 16:30Z, proxy de-throttled some clients.
jen: update 20m: several parts succeeded, but CompleteMultipartUpload still failing intermittently.
tasha: time check: 16:40Z. 20m left. product signs off on promoting previous digest to avoid slipping.
dan: decision: manual-promote previous digest now, open hotfix PR for metrics tweak, add to release notes as deferred.
release-bot: manual promote requested: `deployctl promote --from-digest sha256:aa22bb33 --to=staging --reason="mirror finalize failures"`
deploy-bot: promote accepted, audit id=prom-2026-3501 recorded.
jen: created hotfix branch: hotfix/metrics-2026.04 -> PR #489.
rory: created incident INC-2026-0407 for mirror-eu2 and added action item: consider multi-mirror upload fallback.
tasha: release-notes entry: "Rollout to staging deferred due to artifact finalize errors against mirror-eu2; previous build promoted to preserve release window. Metrics dashboard fix scheduled as hotfix (PR #489)."
dan: closing: staging set to sha256:aa22bb33 at 2026-03-23T16:48Z. tagging release manager.
infra-bot: note: mirror-eu2 throttle event logged, mitigation steps in incident ticket.
